description: Run an OCPI charging journey against an endpoint registered on this account, the sandbox or your own, and return its report id. Against your own endpoint it needs the Integrate plan, and a few journeys need a higher one, which chargerdojo_list_journey_templates names. Answers: does my endpoint pass this journey.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

targetId.description: The registered endpoint to run against, from chargerdojo_list_targets.

templateId.description: Journey to run, from chargerdojo_list_runnable_journeys. Omit to run the shortest one that fits the endpoint.

name: chargerdojo_run_journey
title: Run a journey on an endpoint
